name: TikTok
summary: Send videos to a TikTok account to finish in the app, or post them directly after review.

triggers.name: Post status changed
triggers.description: A TikTok post finished processing or failed (webhook).

actions.name: Check posting options
actions.description: Reads which privacy levels, interaction settings and maximum video length this account may use. Required right before every post.

actions.name: List videos
actions.description: Lists the account’s public videos with view and like counts.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Page token returned by the previous call

actions.name: Send a draft to TikTok
actions.description: Sends a video to the creator’s TikTok inbox as a draft. They finish and post it in the TikTok app.

actions.name: Post a video
actions.description: Posts a video directly to TikTok after the owner reviews the caption and settings.

params.name: privacyLevel
params.description: One of the privacy options get_creator_info returned

actions.name: Post photos
actions.description: Posts a photo carousel directly to TikTok after the owner reviews the caption and settings.

params.name: privacyLevel
params.description: One of the privacy options get_creator_info returned

actions.name: Check post status
actions.description: Checks whether a TikTok upload or post finished processing.
